# vendor

Third-party runtime files loaded by generated compositions. Nothing is loaded from a CDN at render time.
Exact versions, each folder keeps its own license.

| Folder | Version | License |
| ------ | ------- | ------- |
| `three/` | three.js 0.186.1 (`three.module.js`, `three.core.js`, selected addons: RoundedBoxGeometry, SVGLoader, EffectComposer with bloom, bokeh, FXAA and output passes) | MIT |
| `gsap/` | GSAP 3.15.0 (`gsap.min.js`; plugins `SplitText`, `DrawSVGPlugin`, `MorphSVGPlugin`, `MotionPathPlugin`, `CustomEase`, from the same `gsap` package) | GreenSock standard "no charge" license, not open source |
| `d3/` | D3 7.9.0 (`d3.min.js`) | ISC |
| `icons/` | Lucide 1.63.0 icons with the `kfIcon()` helper (`lucide.js`, built by `scripts/build-icons.mjs`) | ISC |
| `fonts/` | 15 font families | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |
